gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically verified glioblastoma multiforme with recurrence (first or second relapse, all subtypes) based on the Response Assessment in Neuro-Oncology criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study evaluates the safety associated with the addition of sulfasalazine to stereotactic radiosurgery for recurrent glioblastoma. Sulfasalazine is a potential tumor selective radiosensitizer.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Sulfasalazine and Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Recurrent Glioblastoma

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Intratumoral Glutathione production: Monitor the effect of sulfasalazine on the level of Glutathione production in glioma cells.

role_evidence.quote: Sulfasalazine inhibits the production of an antioxidant that normally protects the tumor against radiation.
Determining the maximum tolerated and recommended dose of sulfasalazine as radiosensitizer.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: radiosensitiser via inhibition of tumour antioxidant (glutathione) production
arms: Sulfasalazine in addition to stereotactic radiosurgery

source_quote.quote: Intratumoral Glutathione production: Monitor the effect of sulfasalazine on the level of Glutathione production in glioma cells.

coder_notes: Single OTHER-type arm with sulfasalazine dose escalation before Gamma Knife SRS; treated as the experimental arm. Glutathione is a metabolic rather than genetic marker; recorded as 'other' pharmacodynamic biomarker.
